more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Dioctyl sodium sulfosuccinate is a surface-active ingredient also known as docusate sodium. Its food role is to help wet and disperse ingredients in specified preparations. FDA describes applications in fumaric-acid-containing dry gelatine desserts, beverage bases and fruit drinks, as well as other narrowly listed processing uses. The permitted amounts depend on the application.
more_info.uses: Specified US applications include fumaric-acid-containing dry gelatine desserts, beverage bases and fruit drinks; unrefined cane-sugar processing; solubilising certain gums; and dispersing cocoa fat in some drinks and cocoa preparations. Application-specific limits apply.
